python_modules.description:
Compare what the UI shows against the expected data.

Katalon equivalent: ``Utils.compareSheetsByRow()`` → ``compareTwoLists()`` /
``normalizeSemicolonList()`` / ``stripCpiBadge()``.

Compare flow (matches Katalon):
  * Sort both sides by whole row (left-to-right column text).
  * Compare row-by-row at the same index; print each cell match or mismatch.
  * A cell matches if ``cells_match(ui, expected)`` (raw, case-insensitive,
    CPI badge stripped, or normalized ``;`` lists).

Row count mismatch fails (Katalon silently passed when expected was empty; we still fail that case).

python_modules.description:
Object repository: locators live in YAML files under ObjectRepository/<app>/.

Katalon equivalent: findTestObject('C3DC/ResultTabs/Studies-Tab')
Commons usage:      repo.xpath('ResultTabs/Studies-Tab')

The lookup key is the same as the Katalon path, minus the app name, so anything you knew in
Katalon is still findable. Filter facets are looked up as *groups*:

    repo.filter_group('Study/dbGaP_Accession').checkbox_xpath('phs000466')

Each filter group is YAML with `facet`, `dropdown`, and `checkboxes` (short key → xpath).
Optional: `search` (typeahead facets), `dropdowns` (two sub-lists), `other` (scroll helpers).
Legacy `checkbox_template` / `values` / `facet_key` are still loaded if present but prefer explicit checkboxes.

python_modules.description:
Loads result-tab behavior from Config/tab_setting.yaml.

Controls how many table rows we compare (UI vs database) and which result tabs
run during a test. Stat bar counts are always checked; this file does not gate them.

YAML keys (see Config/tab_setting.yaml for per-app examples):

  tab_row_limit          — max rows read from the UI and returned from DB query
  pagination_max_pages   — safety cap on "Next page" clicks in the browser
  tabs.<name>: true      — run this tab (read UI + run DB query + compare)
  tabs.<name>: false     — skip this tab (test continues; tab marked SKIPPED)

Shell overrides (row / page caps only; tabs stay in YAML):

  TAB_ROW_LIMIT, TAB_ROW_LIMIT_<APP>
  PAGINATION_MAX_PAGES, PAGINATION_MAX_PAGES_<APP>

Used by settings.get_app_settings, db_source (Cypher LIMIT), table_reader (UI scrape),
and BaseApp.verify_tab (skip disabled tabs).
